queries: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT si.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS all_status_avg_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.avg_rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.scan_count::numeric) AS average_count, AVG(sr.avg_rate - b.all_status_avg_rate) AS average_excess FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE sr.avg_rate > b.all_status_avg_rate;

assumptions.assumption: A zero-minute duration has no defined rate and is excluded from rate averages.
Count means the number of matched scans in each status, including scans without a usable rate.

alternatives.interpretation: Count includes only scans with both a file size and a nonzero duration.
